highlights.title: Choose your half-day leave
highlights.description: For a longer leave period, choose the exact half-day date and AM or PM. See that detail in Calendar and History, and keep it in your exports.

highlights.title: A simpler update message
highlights.description: The up-to-date popup now shows only the confirmation and your app version.

releaseNotes: Choose exactly which date is half-day leave, with morning or afternoon leave clearly recorded. The up-to-date popup now has less text.
